items.title: How Much Do You Really Need Invested to Replace a $120,000 Salary With Dividends?
items.summary: The yield you chase determines whether you need $1 million or $3.4 million, and the one that feels safest might quietly betray you a decade from now.

items.title: Why These 5 Dividend Stocks Are Worth More in a Roth Than a Brokerage Account
items.summary: Holding high-yield BDCs, REITs, and MLPs in a taxable account quietly hands thousands of dollars to the IRS every year, and the account type you choose matters far more than the stocks themselves.

items.title: How to Build $7,800 a Month in Dividend Income Without Owning a Single Yield Trap
items.summary: Chasing a fatter dividend yield can quietly destroy the very income stream you built it to replace. Before you commit a dollar, understand why the yield number that looks most attractive often signals the greatest danger to your principal.

items.title: How to Build $3,100 a Month in Dividend Income Starting From Zero
items.summary: Building $37,200 a year in dividend income is a math problem first, and the yield tier you choose changes the capital required by hundreds of thousands of dollars in ways most investors never calculate before picking their first stock.

items.title: 5 Monthly Dividend Payers That Belong in Your Roth IRA
items.summary: Holding REIT and BDC dividends in a taxable account hands the IRS a cut every single month, and the bracket you sit in determines exactly how much you are giving away. Five monthly payers show just how wide that gap gets inside a Roth.

items.title: How to Build $6,600 a Month in Dividend Income From Three Income Buckets
items.summary: Reaching $6,600 a month in dividend income sounds like a single-number problem, but the capital you actually need swings by more than a million dollars depending on which yield tier you choose and what you give up to get there.

items.title: I Get Paid By 3 Different Dividend Stocks Every Single Month. Here's Who's on My List.
items.summary: These dividend stocks work together to provide me with monthly income.

items.title: The Portfolio Blueprint for Building $19,000 a Month in Dividend Income
items.summary: Generating $19,000 a month from dividends alone sounds like a single problem with one answer, but the yield you chase changes the required nest egg by millions and introduces a completely different set of risks, tax consequences, and long-term tradeoffs.
